gen-righteous-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Righteous fills every line with fat, rounded bowls, like a thin steel rod bent into letters. Sofia Sans Condensed follows with a big x-height and unfinished curves, so bump its size up a touch.
gen-righteous-gf-spline-sans-mono: Spline Sans Mono sets fixed-width, code-style letters in one bold stroke, with lowercase nearly matching the capitals. And Righteous above it keeps things loud, so a long passage feels precise and mechanical, with a grin.
gen-righteous-gf-strait: Strait reads with big round lowercase bowls that feel friendly and open, set under the steel-rod swagger of Righteous. Pages move along easily.
gen-righteous-gf-tiny5: Righteous has no hairline anywhere, just thick, rod-like strokes bent into shape. Tiny5 is a tall sans whose ascenders look short, so the pair's strongest quality is a chunky, toy-like friendliness.
gen-righteous-gf-truculenta: Righteous bends a thin steel rod into bowls that fill the line, while Truculenta packs a tall x-height into a compact sans. They sit snugly together.
gen-righteous-gf-ubuntu: Ubuntu reads modern and lofty, its lowercase band standing tall across the line. And Righteous, bent from a single length of wire, gives that sans a bold, playful neighbor.
gen-righteous-gf-victor-mono: Precise is the first word for Victor Mono, with loose spacing and bowls left open on one side. If Righteous were shrunk down, its commanding, fun bowls would lose their punch beside the monospace.
gen-righteous-gf-viga: Righteous pairs rod-bent, line-filling bowls with Viga, a sans-serif whose capitals barely rise above its lowercase. And Viga's hairline-free strokes look best with the body size nudged up.
gen-righteous-gf-voces: Righteous draws an unmodulated line across every glyph, with no swelling anywhere. But Voces brings tall lowercase and a modest contrast, like lightly engraved brass, so long paragraphs feel orderly.
gen-righteous-gf-winky-rough: Punchy and playful, Righteous looks traced with one marker tip, while Winky Rough sits beneath it as a plain sans with near-capital lowercase. Righteous earns its place big and short.
